items.title_en: Indian in Norway compares vegetable prices: ‘Are we failing our farmers’
items.title_zh: 挪威的印度人比较蔬菜价格：“我们辜负了我们的农民吗”
items.summary_en: According to Vinod, organic lemons were priced at Rs 850 per kg, tomatoes at Rs 680 per kg, while a single cucumber cost Rs 300.
items.summary_zh: 据维诺德介绍，有机柠檬的售价为每公斤 850 卢比，西红柿为每公斤 680 卢比，而一根黄瓜的售价为 300 卢比。

items.title_en: Ex-Meta exec says Mark Zuckerberg taught him work-life balance: ‘It is a marathon, not a sprint’
items.title_zh: 前 Meta 高管表示，马克·扎克伯格教会了他工作与生活的平衡：“这是一场马拉松，而不是短跑”
items.summary_en: Martin Ott said one of his biggest takeaways from working under Zuckerberg was learning how to use limited time effectively rather than trying to fill every available hour with work.
items.summary_zh: 马丁·奥特表示，在扎克伯格手下工作的最大收获之一就是学习如何有效利用有限的时间，而不是试图用工作来填满每一个小时。

items.title_en: ‘Don’t come with under Rs 1 lakh salary’: Techie slams Bengaluru’s ‘overpriced’ lifestyle
items.title_zh: “不要拿着低于10万卢比的薪水”：技术人员抨击班加罗尔“价格过高”的生活方式
items.summary_en: A Bengaluru product manager has sparked an online debate after claiming that the city's commercialisation has made Rs 12 LPA feel like Rs 4 LPA.
items.summary_zh: 班加罗尔的一位产品经理声称该城市的商业化让 12 卢比的 LPA 感觉就像 4 卢比的 LPA，这在网上引发了一场争论。

items.title_en: ‘Shivering with happiness’: Anant Ambani offers to fund Rs 9 crore treatment for 23-month-old Vedansh
items.title_zh: “幸福得发抖”：阿南特·安巴尼 (Anant Ambani) 愿意为 23 个月大的维丹什 (Vedansh) 提供 9 千万卢比的治疗资金
items.summary_en: Vedansh Singh, who is battling Spinal Muscular Atrophy Type 1, had become the focus of a fundraising campaign led by Mumbai-based influencer Mayuresh Gujar and his team.
items.summary_zh: 正在与 1 型脊髓性肌肉萎缩症作斗争的维丹什·辛格 (Vedansh Singh) 已成为孟买网红 Mayuresh Gujar 及其团队领导的筹款活动的焦点。

items.title_en: ‘A hero’: Trump on Indian pilot Smit Machchhar after mid-air cockpit attack
items.title_zh: “英雄”：特朗普在印度飞行员斯密特·马赫恰尔（Smit Macchhar）遭遇空中驾驶舱袭击后将其称为“英雄”
items.summary_en: Flydubai flight FZ1073, travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30, was forced to make an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
items.summary_zh: 9月30日，迪拜航空FZ1073航班从迪拜飞往特拉维夫，被迫紧急降落在沙特阿拉伯塔布克。

items.title_en: ‘Aviation wasn’t a childhood dream’: What flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar said in old interview
items.title_zh: “航空不是儿时的梦想”：迪拜航空飞行员 Smit Macchhar 在旧采访中说道

items.title_en: The Tragic Story Of The Titanic Lifeboats — And The Role They Played In The Infamous Sinking
items.title_zh: 泰坦尼克号救生艇的悲惨故事——以及它们在臭名昭著的沉没事件中所扮演的角色
items.summary_en: National Archives and Records Administration Of the 20 Titanic lifeboats, just 18 were launched — and most of them weren’t even filled. On April 14, 1912, at 11:40 p.m., the RMS Titanic struck an iceberg in the North Atlantic. Just over two hours later, at 2:05 a.m., the last of the Titanic lifeboats was launched from the ship. This boat, Collapsible Boat D, hit the water 15 minutes before the vessel sank beneath the waves forever.
items.summary_zh: 国家档案和记录管理局在泰坦尼克号的 20 艘救生艇中，只有 18 艘下水了，而且其中大多数甚至还没有装满。 1912 年 4 月 14 日晚上 11 点 40 分，泰坦尼克号在北大西洋撞上冰山。两个多小时后，凌晨 2 点 05 分，泰坦尼克号最后一艘救生艇从船上下水。这艘名为“Collapsible Boat D”的船于 15 分钟前入水，随后永远沉没在海浪之下。

items.title_en: This 2,800-Year-Old Palace Discovered In Ethiopia May Have Been One Of The World’s Very First ‘Skyscrapers’
items.title_zh: 在埃塞俄比亚发现的这座拥有 2800 年历史的宫殿可能是世界上最早的“摩天大楼”之一
items.summary_en: ⓒartefacts-berlin.de, DAI Orient Department // Mike Schnelle, Building Research A new study has shown that the Grat Be’al Gibri palace at Yeha could have supported 16-19 floors. Today, the world’s great skyscrapers, built with steel frames and concrete, reach heights of more than 2,000 feet. Although the skyscraper may seem like a symbol of modernity itself, the fact is that, thousands of years ago, ancient builders were attempting to reach great heights as well.
